notes.title: New Diebrary Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Diebrary Patch 1.1.1: Auto Aim and Fire![/h1]

[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]

In this patch we've added [b]two new gameplay settings[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/15916d20d641fd09e4a0468a3744a60c35c71801.gif[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Auto Aim[/b][list]
    [*]When enabled, automatically point your primary weapon in the direction of the nearest enemy
[/list]
    [*][b]Auto Shoot[/b][list]
    [*]Your Fire-button becomes a toggle for automatically firing your primary weapon
    [*]Quickly toggle off shooting to reach a pet in need of rescue, then toggle it back on to resume the carnage!
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where damage would be increased +12% each level with no drawback
[/list]

tags.feature: In this patch we've added two new gameplay settings

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where damage would be increased +12% each level with no drawback

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/ad3f998016800fb8d23be4813166a033506d18a0.png[/img]

[h1][b]Diebrary Update 1.1.0: SHMUP Fest![/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]

We've heard your feedback! Many players have said that the base game speed is too slow, so we have [b]increased the overall pace of gameplay.[/b] While the 15 minute timer remains the same, the game itself is a bit faster paced - with characters and enemies all moving faster, shooting faster, and generally being more action-packed.

[h2][b]Pets[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Added Charlotte, a cute potted plant that will periodically grant you powerful buffs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/63d1665087baea4db4617ff8281b200c79b10916.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/ae0d893e586ec0a748037b8fecc2d63719cdf1d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/7bc5a201d88f310785327fdb4394269ace907d0f.png[/img]

    [*]Added Painterly, an adorable sea turtle that will send out a tsunami, pushes foes back

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/957257c2b17800859fa661d584576aa0ce30c7b8.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2][b]Plot Twists[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]We've added [Hard] and [Brutal] warnings on some of the most dangerous Plot Twists
    [*]Butterfingers: Reworked! Now deals much more damage to enemies, and tosses XP more consistently in all directions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/26afdc3aaa1f9e08ea141d7f74d116ad19b7bbca.gif[/img]

    [*]A Shocking Number of Explosions: Reworked! Now several smaller explosions can appear back-to-back, instead of a single large one. This can be used to your advantage, chain-explode enemies!
    [*]Paranormal Exercise: Ghost duration reduced from 10 -> 7s
    [*]Spring-Time Dancing: We lowered the difficulty/insanity of this act 1 twist
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fixed several crash bugs
    [*]Fixed an issue with knockback sending enemies extremely far away
[/list]

notes.title: DIEBRARY AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/6056df67c4e6d0925e7465b514b27f724265b708.png[/img]

[h1]Diebrary IS AVAILABLE NOW![/h1]

Please share the news with your friends, and don't forget to post a review!

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]

[h3]:steam: V1.0.0 IS HERE! :steam:[/h3]

[b]Our full version features:[/b][list]
    [*]5 Playable Characters
    [*]14 Weapons
    [*]400- Upgrades
    [*]2 Maps: Forest and Mountain
    [*]50+ Plot Twists[list]
    [*]Destroy the King Shriekers
    [*]Go Berserk! Become ENRAGED!
    [*]Drink from Fountains of Mana
    [*]Eat a Spicy Pepper
    [*]Become a Spectral Farmer
    [*]Suffer from Temporal Distortion
    [*]...and many more!
[/list]
    [*]76 Steam Achievements
[/list]

[h1] Gameplay[/h1]

[h2] [b]New Map: Mountain![/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Ascend the snowy mountain, overcoming all-new enemies and the elements, skate through ice patches and avoid massive snowballs. Good luck up there!
[/list]

[h2] [b]Upgrades[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Added 2 upgrade diamonds[/b] (8 upgrades)
    [*][b]Added 2 secret upgrades[/b]
    [*]Several upgrades now also grant bonuses to pets: [b]All Ignite, Poison, and ||REDACTED||[/b] upgrade diamonds, and a few others
[/list]

[h2] [b]Boss Upgrades[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Added 2 boss upgrades[/b]
    [*][b]Faster Than Before:[/b] Now lowers the cooldown of the character skill substantially more
    [*]Several upgrades now also grant bonuses to pets: [b]Chain Reaction, Forest Fire, Master of Elements[/b]
[/list]

[h2] [b]Weapons[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Added 3 new secondary weapons![/b]
    [*][b]Wand:[/b] Weapon art overhauled, check out the new look!
    [*][b]Wand: Noxious Leak:[/b] Now requires only 2 hits to spawn the poison pool
    [*][b]Tesla Coil:[/b] Decreased a hidden attack size buff on several of the base tree upgrades
    [*][b]Tesla Coil:[/b] Cooldown slightly increased
    [*][b]Acid Bottles:[/b] Upgrades that recover cooldown while standing in the pool nerfed substantially
    [*][b]Nikola's Scope: Pretty Overpowered Laser:[/b] Chance for OP beam moderately decreased
[/list]

[h2] [b]Characters[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Added 2 new characters![/b]
[/list]

[b]Barbarian[/b][list]
    [*][b]Aura:[/b] Range slightly decreased, [b]Terrified Approach[/b] upgrade now applies Chill
    [*][b]Tumble Roll:[/b] Fast Rolls now grants a visual buff. Fearsome Roar damage scales better with run duration. Destructive Rollout now grants a damage buff.
[/list]

[h2] [b]Pets[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Completely rebalanced Pets!
    [*]With luck and upgrades, you can do a full-fledged Pet build
    [*]Added a Pet upgrade diamond
    [*]Bucky (the unicorn) stomps in a slightly smaller area
[/list]

[h2] [b]Other Stuff[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*]Improved a number of keybindings
    [*]Lots of small UI improvements on different screens
    [*]You can now skip voting on a Plot Twist
    [*]Doom's explosion size was slightly lowered, but there's a ton more ways to get Doom now!
    [*]All enemies now have biggified versions
    [*]Magnet range buffed
    [*]Added a fourth tier of XP pickup that will show up with some Plot Twists
[/list]

[h1] [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

There were hundreds of bugs fixed prior to launch. Here are a few highlights:[list]
    [*]Fixed and improved lots of assets, missing or incomplete animations
    [*]Fixed issues with sounds playing too frequently/at the same time
    [*]Improvements to performance on the Steam build using native tools
    [*]Shiny (the pet) will no longer cause his other pet friends to orbit you wildly
    [*]Fixed a bunch of issues where upgrades weren't correctly showing what they will apply to
[/list]

notes.title: Diebrary Dev Blog Post #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/49c18a8b64d62094ea163dfbd6ca28b03fe2dc9d.png[/img]

In order to best prepare for our [b]release on Steam on the 20th[/b], we have decided to disable the Demo version. 

You can still get your Diebrary demo at Armor Games, Itch.io, Addicting Games, Kongregate and other portals for free!

We got a few questions about the cookies in web versions - they are there only to save your progress, and you can opt-out of that. We do not collect or store any user information. It's up to you how you want to enjoy our game!

[h3]4. What did we have to change? (Color)[/h3]

Alright, we’re going to get a bit more specific with art terminology here so feel free to leave questions if you are curious about something!

As was mentioned before, we reused a lot of assets to make the pipeline faster. However, just because one thing worked in Loot, doesn’t mean it worked in Diebrary. Characters, enemies and props were the main thing we carried over, but reworking the color palettes across all of those assets was an important part of getting those to look cohesive, like they belonged in the same world. Here is an early look of Diebrary before the color pass and an up to date screenshot after the color pass and with some extra pizazz. 

Before (Forest)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/dd52b53cad21f4f33dbad240f1f8d1f31bdd5575.png[/img]

After (Forest)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/bebf81ea01631ee27d80c19aa56fc7272a7e4998.png[/img]

At first glance it might not seem like a huge difference, however, take a closer look at the colors in the environment and on the enemies. The before shot is less saturated, has more blue tones overall and the red is slightly more orange.

In the second screen shot, we’ve taken out as much of the blue as we could and leaned more heavily into the true red/yellow-gold/rich greens. Sticking with those as our primary colors made it easier to come up with color changes for enemies and helped tremendously while making a color pass on the environment props. 

These are color swatches our art director, Ben, took from our first color pass and the changes he suggested for the next pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/912ff8ce9177926d020de12c6bf31db7f66d0b85.png[/img]

First pass colors that include the ultramarine blue tone

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/91c4292c98da123cc645f191001801ea70b62c1c.png[/img]

After, less blue and that good ol’ green/red/yellow-gold triad

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/cba021632d52f67911391dbafac2b3e43d96da44.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/34ef62996afa8c4c1f85504ba8f6aa86fed8e470.png[/img]

I hope the images above helped with your understanding of this part of our art journey!

[h3]5. What did we have to change? (Enemies!)[/h3]
Fans of this genre (games like Vampire Survivors, Nova Drift, 20 Minutes Till Dawn) know that the bulk of the enemies come from using one model and changing it visually to show that it has gotten tougher than the previous version. Today I am going to use the shamblers as an example of how we achieved this. 

First of all, this is what the shambler looked like in Loot. I wanted to make it cuter as a way to separate it from its first life, the “shambling mound”, and turn it into the first enemy you see in Diebrary.

Original Shambling (from Loot)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/c15a8a6e74b8f55540cdfa32744ace2ae6e7c268.png[/img]

New Shambler

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/7e50fb9f08564b7023e7743dec2d08bd5acedb39.png[/img]

This is also a good example of how we kept the color palette for enemies to the yellow-gold/red. Dipping into some deep yellow/orange in this case makes sense for the visual progression.

[h3]6. New Map![/h3]
Initially we were only going to ship with one map, but as luck (and a lot of work!) would have it, we were able to create a new map that has some mechanical differences from the Forest.

The Mountain map features almost all new enemies, props and visual effects. While running up the mountain, you are a bit slower. If you’re running down the mountain, you’re faster! Storms on the left and right sides of the screen block your path, and monsters emerge from within to make your life more difficult. Overall more movement restricted, hopefully more hectic and fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/670e0f1f90fe2177da9841f1ad89ba6c87c0a24d.png[/img]

[h3]7. Thank you for reading![/h3]

Unfortunately there are a lot more things to talk about than what will comfortably fit inside a reasonably sized blog post. If you enjoyed reading, from the small amount of history with our other game Loot, to our work on palettes and our work on enemies, characters and weapons, we hope you found something new to learn about! If you have any questions and would like to know more (art post part 3!) OR want us to spotlight another team, please let us know in the comments! 

It was a privilege to speak on behalf of the art team for Diebrary and I hope you’ll give the game a shot when it comes to steam on July 20th!

Thanks!
- Shelbo

notes.title: Diebrary DEMO on NEXT FEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/b3c75b2822b67559e7803054f7156dd0f8a4fc20.png[/img]

[b]Hello Diebrarians! [/b]

Massive shout out to those who have tried our demo prior the Next Fest and gave us feedback - we're now BACK with a PATCH that will make everyone's experience even better!

Now go PLAY some Diebrary! Wishlist it! Spread the word!

[h1]Diebrary Patch 0.9.1: Steam Demo[/h1]

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]

[h3] :steam: [b]STEAM SUPPORT![/b] Our demo is now playable on Steam! :steam: [/h3]
[list]
[*]Added many common Steam features:
	[*]Fullscreen, windowed, and borderless fullscreen
	[*]Resolution support, including reworking many screens to work at lower resolution
	[*]More keybindings to navigate menus
[*]Added controller support! We're still working on improving this, so we'd love to hear your feedback! 
[url=https://discord.gg/62tHysxjny]https://discord.gg/62tHysxjny[/url]
[*]Added our splash screen
[*]Visual enhancements, like godrays, screen effects, animations, PFX, and more!
[*]Performance improvements, especially on chapter 10[*]stories
[/list]

[h1] Gameplay[/h1]
[h2] [b]Upgrades[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Poisonous Concoction [:recycle: Rework]:[/b] Now spreads poison to nearby targets
[*][b]Pierce:[/b] Removed damage penalty
[*][b]Chaining Attack:[/b] Removed damage penalty
[*][b]Rapid Deployment:[/b] Now grants reload speed to everything, not just your character's skill
[*][b]Only A Spark:[/b] Ignite chance buffed
[*][b]Dry Heat:[/b] Ignite chance buffed
[*][b]Poison-Coated Weapons:[/b] Poison chance buffed
[*][b]Dripping With Venom:[/b] Poison chance buffed
[*][b]Kill Trigger:[/b] Now requires 150 kills to trigger the (now bigger) explosion, and fires a random secondary weapon instead of *all* secondary weapons
[/list]

[h2][b]Boss Upgrades[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Broken Heart Weeps Open:[/b] Damage taken reduced, max hearts buffed to +3
[*][b]I'd Rather Be Rich:[/b] Now makes you much richer
[*][b]Joker's Wild:[/b] Adds luckiness to upgrades
[*][b]Master of Elements:[/b] Ailment potency buffed, damage penalty reduced
[*][b]Faster Than Before:[/b] Attack rate buffed, damage penalty reduced
[/list]

[h2][b]Weapons[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Spear [:recycle: Rework]:[/b] Base damage massively buffed, and most upgrades that granted damage now grant base damage, which stacks better with other damage% upgrades
[*]Spear upgrades that were buffed: [b]Better Grips, Whirling Dervish Style, Stalwart Soldier Style, Naginata Mastery, and all three Evolutions: Dragon Naginata, Saint's Spear, Grand Pike[/b]
[*][b]Boomerang: Catch 'Em All [:recycle: Rework]:[/b] Now grants huge attack size, and buff power increased substantially
[*][b]Boomerang: Outback Boomerang:[/b] Massively buffed swirling damage, and grants a bonus projectile
[*][b]Boomerang: Angular Momentum:[/b] Swirl radius slightly decreased to feel better and strike the same enemy more often, now has a large damage bonus
[*][b]Boomerang: Hard Knocks:[/b] Now grants base damage
[*][b]Boomerang: Evolve: Outback Ringer:[/b] Now grants a second orbiting boomerang
[*][b]Wand: Lightning Always Strikes Twice [:recycle: Rework]:[/b] Now triggers on Wand kills and more often on Wand shots, but less often on other weapon damage
[*][b]Wand: Noxious Leak:[/b] Ammo buffed, base damage of pool buffed, and pool now grows much faster
[*][b]Wand: Mark Aim Fire:[/b] Now grants massive Doom potency
[*][b]Wand: Evolve: Strategic Striker:[/b] Damage buffed
[*][b]Wand: Gatling Sorceries:[/b] Reload speed massively buffed
[*][b]Crossbow:[/b] Charge speed buffed
[*][b]Acid Bottles: Soaking It In:[/b] Now grants bonus damage, and less attack rate
[*][b]Nikola's Scope:[/b] Now fires slightly slower, but hits much harder
[*][b]Nikola's Scope: Accelerated Technology:[/b] Attack rate reduced
[*][b]BEES:[/b] Base speed buffed, pause after spawning shortened
[*][b]BEES: Absolute Units:[/b] Now has a Pierce multiplier
[*][b]BEES: Attack of the Killer Wasps:[/b] Poison potency buffed
[*][b]BEES: Bees Forever:[/b] Pierce multiplier buffed
[*][b]BEES: Weight Training:[/b] Now grants a bunch of pierce
[*][b]BEES: CHONKERS:[/b] Bee size slightly reduced, but still chonky
[/list]

[h2] [b]Characters[/b][/h2]
[b]Barbarian[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Aura:[/b] Range buffed
[/list]

[b]Ranger[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Trap:[/b] Slowing area buffed
[*][b]Ranger's Mark: Damaging Mark:[/b] The mark will now immediately jump to another target when the current target dies
[/list]

[b]Cone Dog[/b]
[list]
[*][b]All Cone Dog upgrades[/b]: Will now roll more frequently
[*][b]Frenetic Activity:[/b] Now increases Thorn damage
[*][b]Spiney:[/b] Thorns now travel further
[*][b]Natural Defense:[/b] Thorns now chill
[/list]

[h2][b]Pets[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Massive buffs to the cooldown of Shiny (crystal pet), Lil' Ninja (cat pet), Rot Son (poison pet), and Bucky (unicorn pet)
[/list]

[h2][b]Other Stuff[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Boss health increased for all acts
[*]Hearts now fade away after 60 seconds
[*]Improved the glossary (tooltip) text for damage-over-time, explaining their mechanics better
[*]Made a few hectic "choreograph" Plot Twists a little bit easier (these are the ones where enemies spawn in silly patterns)
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
There were over 150 bugs fixed from the web version of the game, so we'll detail some of the most important ones:
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with Spear's hitbox, especially the unevolved form
[*]Fixed an issue where Magic Tomes you earned didn't show up until you reloaded the game, or bought a Perk
[*]Fixed several issues with Solo stories not immediately showing their new Plot Twist, or awarding Magic Tomes in some cases
[*]Fixed several issues with Voting indicators for Plot Twists
[*]Fixed a lot of small issues with different Plot Twists, such as Shambling Towers being revived by Twice Dead, or Combat Arena spawning right on your head and trapping you
[*]Fixed many spammy sounds playing simultaneously and getting too loud
[*]Performance improvements to many laggy weapons, upgrades, and PFX
[*]Performance improvements for damage numbers
[/list]
